product_one_liner.value: Axure RP lets UX professionals, business analysts, and product managers design, prototype, document, and share realistic interactive software experiences without coding.

employee_band.notes: The latest dated count is 17 employees as of September 30, 2026; older directory estimates are higher.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains product announcements, tutorials, UX articles, and company updates, rather than at least two engineer-authored articles on building the product.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes reference guides and tutorials covering pages, widgets, interactions, publishing, and more.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The readable job board lists Software Engineer and Software Developer; the accessible company posting is Product Support Specialist. None has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title. The main careers index could not be retrieved.

model_provider.notes: No underlying model or provider is disclosed in the documentation, privacy/security material, blog, or subprocessor list reviewed. MCP connects to user-selected AI tools such as Claude Code, VS Code, and Cursor; this does not establish an Axure-supplied model.

compliance_certs.notes: Axure also states PCI compliance for transmitting card data, but the explicit PCI DSS Level 1 claim belongs to its third-party payment processor, so it is not listed as an Axure certification.

last_funding.notes: Sources conflict: Tracxn labels Axure unfunded; CB Insights lists an undated Other Investors round involving Steve Blank. Separately, SBA-derived records identify a $611,400 PPP loan approved April 13, 2020, while Owler reports $350,000. A most-recent outside funding round, date, and amount cannot be established reliably.

raised_18mo.notes: For May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026: the funding profile updated November 5, 2026 reports no funding rounds; the latest dated financing identified is the April 2020 PPP loan. An undated investor entry elsewhere does not establish a raise in this window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable job board lists Software Engineer and Software Developer; the accessible company posting is Product Support Specialist. None has a qualifying SDR, BDR, or account-executive title. The main careers index could not be retrieved.

launched_6mo.notes: September 24, 2026: Axure introduced an experimental built-in local MCP server in Axure RP, giving AI tools access to pages, widgets, interactions, and notes for code generation, analysis, and documentation; this is within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated C-level or VP appointment/departure was verified for November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. No complete, dated corporate leadership roster was available to establish a negative; the company’s /team page describes product collaboration rather than its leadership.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The subprocessor list identifies HubSpot for email marketing and analytics, Mailchimp for email marketing, Google Analytics, and WuFoo for forms; it does not establish use of Salesforce CRM merely by naming Slack’s owner.
